body.name: support-aware completeness handle
body.construction: Starting from the normalized primitive carrier and retained constraints, apply the initial-token compiler and expose exactly four finite transition relations: support-licensed selector correction, reachable fixing, labelled rational elimination, and residual certificate compilation.  The compiler regenerates the agenda by the standard recursive ID case splitter and declares a state residual-ready only when removal of nonancestors, proper-district splitting, and reachable fixing are all inapplicable.  Carry polynomial identities and branch denominators with each state; at an irreducible residual search the finite projection and signed-row-swap libraries for either an observable rational circuit or one common response-table contrast that preserves all contexts in \(H\).
